_about: Cassiodorus in English: Thomas Hodgkin's condensed translation of the Variae (1886), clean Gutenberg. The Variae are the state letters of the Ostrogothic court (secular), so they sit with the late Latin authors here; the Institutiones and the Psalm commentary belong to lane A if wanted.

cassiodorus-hodgkin-letters: The Letters of Cassiodorus, being a condensed translation of the Variae Epistolae (1886)
